Support: inflation cools, yields soften, demand broadens.

Pressure: sticky inflation, higher yields, tighter funding.

04

October liquidity-reset sequence

Bearish price action can sit inside a bullish higher-timeframe thesis.
RECOVERY NOT CONFIRMED
1 / DRAWDOWN

Supply released

Selling, stops and liquidations meet resting bids. Falling OI can indicate positions closing.

→
2 / ABSORPTION

Downside stalls

Heavy selling stops extending the lows. Repeated tests reveal whether bids absorb supply.

→
3 / RECLAIM

Structure shifts

Displacement through the lost range or swing level; acceptance above, then a retest holds.

→
4 / EXPANSION

Offers consumed

Spot demand persists; available offers clear at higher prices and participation broadens.

CONFIRMS THE RESET THESIS

Sweep of prior lows → prompt reclaim → higher low → spot-led continuation. Leverage normalizes; breadth follows.

INVALIDATES THE RESET READ

Acceptance below support, failed reclaims and lower highs; weak spot demand or financial conditions keep deteriorating.

A decline is not proof of accumulation or deliberate buyer manipulation. Price can also advance without a prior crash. The mandatory October flush and “bull of the decade” are the user's central scenario, not established market laws.
